topic: be the one who breaks the cycle
lines: #If you're the first one in your family trying to do it *differently*...
Sometimes even the people you love don't *understand* what you're doing.
#They might call it a phase. They might *doubt* you.
They might wish you'd just be *normal.*
You saw that the pattern doesn't have to *continue.*
You're carrying the pain of the past, and building a future at the *same* time.
That's twice the work. And nobody *claps* for it.
#But one day, someone will grow up *without* what you went through.
Because you decided it would *end* with you.
Keep going. They're counting on you, even if they don't know it *yet.*
end: Send this to someone breaking the cycle.

cover.sub: If you're the first, this is for you

post.title: To the One Breaking the Cycle
post.caption: It's lonely being the first. But it ends with you. 🌅
post.first_comment: Type 'IT ENDS WITH ME' if this is you 👇
